controls.procedure: Classify terminal lineage after any post-handoff commit and require a fresh material freeze whenever a non-allowlisted path is written after the prior handoff.
controls.expected: A stale result-only certificate is rejected and a new terminal child is published only after exact-head validation of the current material candidate.
controls.observed: The prior certificate was rejected as stale; the current exact-head candidate is revalidated and this delivery rebuilds its terminal packet before publication.
